newsitem.title: ROMANIA: More companies seek Bucharest bourse quotation.
newsitem.headline: More companies seek Bucharest bourse quotation.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange, faced with tough competition from an over-the-counter (OTC) system due to start trading in less than a month, said on Thursday four more companies were seeking a bourse listing.
It said it would also handle public offerings for 14 state companies soon.
"Competition from the OTC fares well and the prove is that the bourse has moved into action," bourse vice-president Virgil Anastasiu told a news conference.
Romania launched the RASDAQ system, modelled on the U.S. NASDAQ exchange, last Friday. It is undergoing tests and is due to start trading a modest volume of shares by end-October.

Most brokers welcomed the RASDAQ saying it would boost share trading on the Romanian budding capital market but saw it as a threat to the exchange. They said that due to its less strict listing criteria the OTC would be more liquid and could drag investors away from the bourse.

The four new bourse applicants -- adding to another seven which previously said they were seeking a quotation -- include a rubber items manufacturer, a knitwear maker, a ceramics producer and a chemical company.
Bourse officials could not say when the eleven would join the other 13 companies now traded on the exchange.
"There will also be public offers of State Ownership Fund (FPS) shares in 14 companies through the stock exchange," Anastasiu said.

The FPS, holder of a controlling stake in some 5,000 state enterprises, said it would hold offerings of 14 firms including a beer brewer, a medicine producer, a pulp and paper factory, a plastics maker, as well as the national travel operator ONT Carpati SA and the country's sole newsprint maker Letea SA.
The offerings will be handled by a syndicate of brokers working on the Bursa de Valori Bucuresti exchange.
The FPS did not say when the public offers were scheduled or how many shares it planned to sell. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
